workspaceBusy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
workspaceDefinitionSaved: Definition saved to the shared draft.
workspaceImageUploaded: Image uploaded privately. Choose its exact version, then save the artwork field.
workspaceAssetArchived: Asset selection updated. Existing versions and references are retained.
workspaceContentCreated: New content saved to the shared draft. Configure, test and publish it when ready.
workspaceNotesSaved: Private notes saved. Published content is unchanged.
workspaceReleaseRestored: Previous release restored for future games.
workspaceRecordUnavailable: The edited record is unavailable in the shared draft. Keep editing to copy the retained values, or discard them.
workspaceConflictSave: Review the latest shared values before saving.
workspaceScenarioSave: This unsaved test setup has no draft save. Keep editing to start it, or discard it.
workspaceCreationSave: Keep editing to finish creating this record, or discard the creation form.
workspaceSeparateScopes: These are separate save scopes. Save each named record below; private notes remain separate.
workspaceDefinitionSave: Keep editing to save this definition in its editor.
workspaceDepartureScope: Save the selected records, keep editing, or discard only this browser’s changes.
workspacePrivateNotes: Private deck notes are separate. Save them in Private notes.
workspaceDefinitionsUnavailable: Definitions are unavailable until shared authoring reconnects.
workspaceChooseContent: Search the library or select an item to inspect its saved values, preview, and connections.
workspaceUnsavedPreview: Unsaved changes in this browser. Saved previews exclude these edits.
workspaceDraftBoundary: Saved to the shared draft is separate from published and verified active.
workspaceAssetPicker1: No matching assets. Try another search.
workspaceCardWorkshop1: Local edits are not included in this preview. Save changes to update it.
workspaceCardWorkshop2: No saved validation issues for this card.
workspaceCardWorkshop3: No collector artwork is registered for this card.
workspaceContentBrowser1: No matches in this catalog. Clear the filters or try another name.
workspaceDeckWorkshop1: Save changes to include your local edits in this preview.
workspaceDeckWorkshop2: Resolve validation errors to preview this selection.
workspaceDeckWorkshop3: This recipe has no replacement cards. Add supported cards in Composition to see their selected printings here.
workspaceDeckWorkshop4: Publishing changes this recipe for future use. Players keep the compositions already copied into their library.
workspaceDeckWorkshop5: Saved separately. These notes are never included in a content release.
workspaceDeckWorkshop6: This campaign deck uses its existing scripted composition. Edit its supported details or inspect the related encounter.
workspaceDeckWorkshop7: No saved validation issues for this recipe.
workspaceDeckWorkshop8: Validation describes saved values. Save your changes before testing.
workspaceDeckWorkshop9: Choose a supported authored recipe to test its saved composition.
workspaceDeckWorkshop10: Choose a recipe to edit its details, composition and store connections. Use Create or Duplicate to begin a new supported recipe.
workspaceEngineWorkshop1: No matching rules. Try a name, effect or faction.
workspaceEngineWorkshop2: This faction contract has no editable parameters.
workspaceOfferWorkshop1: This preview uses saved terms. Save changes to update it.
workspaceOfferWorkshop2: Changes save to the shared draft and take effect after publication. Existing receipts retain their captured purchase terms.
workspaceOfferWorkshop3: Choose a product to review its presentation and terms. Create a supported deck product to connect a tested recipe to the store.
workspacePrintingWorkshop1: No printings match these filters. Clear the search or include archived printings.
workspacePrintingWorkshop2: Printing changes save to this printing record. Card rules and wording have a separate save scope.
workspaceReleaseReview1: Draft → Validate → Preview / Test → Review → Publish → Verify active
workspaceReleaseReview2: Every saved change below is included. Publication is shared across all content and competition workshops.
workspaceReleaseReview3: Changes saved in any workshop will appear here. Choose content from the navigation to begin a new draft.
workspaceReleaseReview4: Shared authoring is currently unavailable. Check the connection in Operations before publishing.
workspaceReleaseReview5: Resolve saved validation errors, then validate the draft.
workspaceReleaseReview6: Preview this exact saved draft before release review.
workspaceReleaseReview7: Record an accepted engine action for this exact draft. A visual preview does not provide test evidence.
workspaceReleaseReview8: The existing publication must finish or be resolved before another release.
workspaceReleaseReview9: Release comparison is loading or unavailable. Refresh Admin to retry.
workspaceReleaseReview10: Discards saved draft changes across every workshop and both operators. The active release remains unchanged. This requires confirmation.
workspaceEncounterWorkshop1: Local edits are not included. Save changes to refresh the briefing.
workspaceEncounterWorkshop2: Story and dialogue appear in the player briefing. Each audio entry follows its corresponding dialogue line.
